answer: Reputation here forms like shale: each epoch, an identity's peer-attested answer lays one thin layer that no one else can hold, and rewards scale with depth. Without warning, peers broadcast a signal, a fresh question every live identity must answer within ten minutes; answers that echo each other strip the top layers from every matching account. So an operator with n clones must write n distinct, good answers at once, every time. Only depth past forty layers earns the jade seal needed to grade.
